response.overview: The 2012 Amon Tobin Boxset (released 21/25 May 2012 on Ninja Tune, limited to 4,000 copies) included 2 DVDs as part of its massive package of 6×10" vinyl, 7 CDs, and posters, all bolted together in a plywood "press" case. The DVDs thoroughly document Amon Tobin's celebrated audio-visual live show ISAM, and also include more than a dozen music videos . Specifically, the set contains the ISAM live show DVD alongside the ISAM live audio album, plus remixes, cover versions, and reinterpretations of the ISAM album. It also includes footage of Tobin's music as orchestrated by Ilan Eshkeri and performed by The London Metropolitan Orchestra at a November 2010 concert.
